Updated Call of meeting.

 

The City Council will hold a Special Meeting on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, from 3:00 to 5:00 p.m., in the Sullivan Chamber, Second Floor, City Hall, to continue discussion on POR 2026-195, POR 2026-196, and POR 2026-189.

 

Per POR 2026-203, this meeting will not include public comment. Members of the public are welcome to submit written communications for the record to the City Clerk’s Office at [email protected].

 

Zoom teleconference access will be available for Councillors who wish to participate remotely and for members of the public to view the meeting. The meeting will also be broadcast on the City’s Cable Channel 22 and the City’s Open Meeting Portal.
